root_fix: All 16 cases are now embedded into script.js as a fallback.
If data/cases.json 404s on GitHub Pages, the game still has P001-P016.
Prologue Complete now only triggers when the current case is P016 and P016 has been solved.
NEXT DAY shows on every result screen before P016, regardless of old completedCases pollution.
Console logs added: MCI CASE LOAD, MCI HOME, MCI NEXT DAY.
why_previous_build_could_fail: If data/cases.json failed to load, old fallbackCases returned only P001.
hasCompletedPrologue used completedCases localStorage for all IDs, so polluted tester localStorage could make Case 1 look like the end.
